previous_audits.chain_closure_explanation: The runner hard-codes the candidate classifications and checks only representative algebra; it does not establish the cited literature-wide claim that each discipline supplies no other applicable theorem. The note also incorrectly says F_0=r^0 is additive, although F_0=1 violates binary additivity.
previous_audits.claim_scope: The ten-candidate Route E classification and its claimed F_p obstruction to deriving scalar additivity from determinant factorization alone.
previous_audits.load_bearing_step: Every surveyed candidate either invokes logarithms to obtain additivity or uses additive functorial structure inapplicable to scalar real-valued partition functions, so none derives the required scalar additivity from independence.
previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: Re-audit after correcting the p=0 statement and supplying restricted-packet evidence or independent arguments for each candidate classification and for the claimed exhaustiveness of the L/D dichotomy.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The determinant, logarithm, and nonzero-power calculations are valid algebraic examples, but the runner encodes rather than derives the load-bearing ten-discipline classification. It neither audits the cited disciplinary authorities nor proves that the stated L/D dichotomy exhausts their potentially applicable constructions. The explicit false p=0 additivity statement additionally prevents the claim from closing on its own terms.
